content:
yeah, confirmed for the synced Lodestar nodes.

Dora:
- deathstar block `0x97ef…fec0` = slot `100511`, epoch `3140` slot 31, status `Orphaned`
- parent = `0x6c65…402c`
- slot `100512` canonical Lighthouse block = `0x7bb1…9540`, also parented to `0x6c65…402c`

Lodestar logs:
- `lodestar-ethrex-1`, `lodestar-erigon-1`, `lodestar-nethermind-1`, `lodestar-nimbusel-1`, `lodestar-reth-1` all logged `Synced - slot: 100511 - head: 0x97ef…fec0` around `11:02:18 UTC`
- then around `11:02:25-26 UTC` they log duty/dependent-root reorgs:
  `priorDependentRoot=0x97ef19…bfec0 -> dependentRoot=0x6c65cb…6402c`
- by `11:02:30 UTC` they all log `Synced - slot: 100512 - head: 0x7bb1…9540`

So yes: Lodestar accepted the delayed deathstar last-slot block as head, then reorged it out when the Lighthouse slot-0 block won. I excluded `lodestar-besu-1` and `lodestar-geth-1` since both were still syncing at that boundary.
